intro: Fast power Weapon with infinitely chained attacks

The Power Axe ingame sports some of the most fluid combat loop out of all melee weapons. Unlike most melee weapons, it does not have a damaging heavy attack, instead relying on its light attacks for its single target damage. Still, users will find its heavy attack's cleave and hitbox more than generous for handing minoris enemies. Thanks to its combo loops, however, one always has an answer for maximizing damage against either a horde or a single high value target. Uniquely, the Power Axe's sprint attack does more damage than other weapons'.

intro: In game, this melee weapon is profiled as a slow but hard hitting weapon, with options for both dueling and crowd control. Its light attacks are comparatively sluggish, though their damage ramps up fairly quickly, and uniquely has splash damage (albeit not super impressive by default). The heavy attack, Power Discharge, is ideal for horde control due to its immense cleave and range, on top of a very healthy amount of damage.

The Omnissiah Axe's unique function is the Omnissian Rush attack, which provides extremely powerful defensive utility that is made only possible because of the Techmarine's exclusive ability to Servo-gunstrike. This combination allows for rapid chaff disruption, while also providing the Techmarine the ability to regenerate armour while being on the move. The rush itself can also be chained into Omnissian Strike or Impaling Thrusts; the former is more akin to a standard sprint attack, but deals comparatively higher damage, whereas the latter can deal tremendous single target damage, if preceding rush was performed for an extended amount of time.
